description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis displays language family categories labeled “Turkic,” “Basque,” “Semitic,” “IE-Indic,” “IE-other,” “IE-Baltic,” “Uralic,” “IE-Germanic,” “IE-Romance,” and “IE-Slavic,” listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “# tasks,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each language family is represented by a single bar with a distinct color; the “IE-Slavic” bar is the longest, extending to approximately 74 tasks, while the “Basque” bar is the shortest, reaching approximately 2 tasks. The “Turkic” bar extends to approximately 8 tasks, the “Semitic” bar to approximately 12 tasks, the “IE-Indic” bar to approximately 16 tasks, the “IE-other” bar to approximately 18 tasks, the “IE-Baltic” bar to approximately 21 tasks, the “Uralic” bar to approximately 24 tasks, the “IE-Germanic” bar to approximately 42 tasks, and the “IE-Romance” bar to approximately 52 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
